articles.summary: PHILADELPHIA, Sept. 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Brandywine Realty Trust (NYSE:BDN) announced today that its Board of Trustees has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.08 per common share and OP Unit payable on October 22, 2026 to holders of record on October 8, 2026.
articles.title: Brandywine Realty Trust Announces Quarterly Common Dividend, and Confirms Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call
